escalation_contract:
Native shared-workspace workers can see current working-tree changes; isolated
workers cannot see uncommitted parent changes. Ask the parent before any work
outside assigned ownership, repository-wide version-control action, work on
another worker's files,
dependency change, branch or index change, operation leaving the machine, or
material architectural, security-sensitive, destructive, or deeply ambiguous
decision. Use `SendMessage` (use `ListAgents` to identify the parent) and wait for the answer; only the parent may
take questions to the user. If the parent channel is unavailable, stop and
report instead of guessing.
lifecycle_contract: Return the evidence report through the foreground Agent result or `SendMessage` for a named background teammate. Claude automatically releases a foreground Agent when its result returns; do not issue a stop operation for that completed worker.

escalation_contract:
Native shared-workspace workers can see current working-tree changes; isolated
workers cannot see uncommitted parent changes. Ask the parent before any work
outside assigned ownership, repository-wide version-control action, work on
another worker's files,
dependency change, branch or index change, operation leaving the machine, or
material architectural, security-sensitive, destructive, or deeply ambiguous
decision. Use the collaboration channel available to the worker and wait for the answer; only the parent may
take questions to the user. If the parent channel is unavailable, stop and
report instead of guessing.
lifecycle_contract: Return the evidence report and stop. The host session lifecycle releases the worker; no nonexistent post-result worker action is required.

escalation_contract:
Pi runs every worker as an isolated `pi --mode json -p --no-session` process
in the parent's working directory: a worker sees current working-tree changes
but never the parent's conversation, and workers cannot message the parent
mid-task. Raise anything outside assigned ownership, any repository-wide
version-control action, work on another worker's files, a dependency change,
a branch or index change, any operation leaving the machine, or any material
architectural, security-sensitive, destructive, or deeply ambiguous decision
in your final evidence report and stop; only the parent may take questions
to the user, and it reads your report when you finish.
lifecycle_contract: Return the evidence report as your final output and end. Pi releases a foreground subagent automatically when its result returns; do not issue any stop operation for that completed worker.

bulk.description: Default worker for routine bounded implementation, commands, and tests needing little interpretation.

quick.description: Preferred worker for trivial, mechanical, single-step work using the least adequate compute.

balanced.description: Analysis-first worker that can also execute; use when lower tiers need more reasoning.

frontier.description: Highest-cost worker for difficult reasoning or execution when lower tiers are insufficient; shortest runtime budget.
